blocks.text: This agreement is made between Northwind Traders (“Supplier”) and Contoso Pty Ltd (“Customer”) on the date of the last signature below.
“Goods” means the products listed in Schedule A. “Delivery Date” means the date stated in a purchase order, or ten business days after the order if no date is stated.

The Supplier shall deliver the Goods to the Customer’s nominated address. Title passes on payment in full; risk passes on delivery. Prices are fixed for twelve months reviewed quarterly, as set out in Schedule B.
Goods must meet the specification in Schedule A. Units are measured in m2 and tolerances are stated as H2O equivalents where relevant. Order codes use the form NW-0000.
Either party may terminate this agreement on thirty days’ written notice.
Signed for and on behalf of the parties.
